headlines.title: Baby girl is one of two deaths in Pennsylvania measles outbreak, coroner said
headlines.description: A 6-week-old baby girl is one of two people with measles who died in Pennsylvania, the Lancaster County coroner said Friday, as the nation’s measles tally hit a new 35-year record of 3,134 cases.

headlines.title: Mother speaks out after family exposed to rabid goats at petting zoo party
headlines.description: A North Carolina mother speaks out after her family was exposed to rabid goats from a local petting zoo. This comes as state health officials recommend over 250 people seek treatment. NBC News’ Anne Thompson reports.

headlines.title: Families in Nebraska say state is taking away vital Medicaid funds from disabled people
headlines.description: Nebraska has slashed Medicaid funds for nearly 900 people with developmental disabilities after using an algorithm to determine eligibility. NBC News' senior investigative reporter Mike Hixenbaugh reports.

headlines.title: See Al Roker and Dylan Dreyer ‘Buddy Up’ at an Aerial Yoga Studio
headlines.description: In the latest installment of “Buddy Up,” TODAY’s Al Roker and Dylan Dreyer try out aerial yoga! See their sky-high workout at NYC’s Om Factory.

headlines.title: Dr. Paul Russell, Pioneering Transplant Surgeon, Dies at 101
headlines.description: Dr. Paul Russell, the groundbreaking surgeon who saved countless lives with his pioneering work to make organ transplants safe and effective, has died at 101. Dr. Russell performed his first kidney transplant in 1963, a surgery that in those days was often fatal. Sunday TODAY’s Willie Geist remembers a life well lived.

headlines.title: Does it feel like your hair is always greasy? Here’s why it could be happening
headlines.description: Causes of greasy hair include genetics, hormonal imbalances and lifestyle. Browse the best ways to treat oily hair from brands like Garnier, Ouai, Batiste and more.

headlines.description: Le Creuset, known for its durable kitchen accessories, just launched Star Trek-themed pieces, including a Dutch oven and cocotte.

headlines.title: Texas AG Paxton investigates military healthcare contractor over denied claims
headlines.description: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton has opened an investigation into a major military healthcare contractor over wrongfully denied medical claims.

headlines.title: Pig kidney works for a record 271 days inside the body of American patient
headlines.description: A New Hampshire man, at death’s door 1 ½ years ago, said Friday he could now have “decades” left after surviving a record 271 days with a transplanted pig kidney — in a procedure that could offer new hope to countless other patients.
